title: Chronicle Scrubber: transaction snapshot workflow and micro-timeline prototype
creator: Maya Patel
description: Proposal for a compact, keyboard-first 'chronicle scrubber' UI to let users quickly surface salient transaction snapshots across long-lived requests. The scrubber is a horizontal micro-timeline with thumbnailed snapshots, correlation-id pinning, and an affordance for per-snapshot metadata (latency, token-cost estimate, top-3 spans). It sits above the full drill-down canvas and provides fast navigation between points of interest without loading the full trace. This ticket captures the prototype screens, interaction spec, a11y requirements, and handoff notes for engineering to implement the lightweight preview API and the thumbnail caching layer.
acceptance_criteria: Micro-timeline component implemented as a single-line scrubber with keyboard left/right/jump-to-mark shortcuts
Each thumbnail loads a precomputed 250x32 snapshot that includes top-3 spans and latency overlay
Click/Enter on a thumbnail opens the detailed drill-down at the selected time segment and highlights the correlation id in the request header pane
Cost estimate shown for each snapshot (tokens * model-rate) and matches Console cost breakdown taxonomy
Component meets contrast and screen-reader labeling standards; scrubber is operable without a mouse
engineering_notes: Needs two new backend endpoints: /trace/snapshots?trace_id=<id>&span_window=<ms> and /snapshot/preview/<snapshot_id>
Precompute top-3 spans and token-cost per snapshot to keep preview payload < 4KB
Client should use low-priority streaming connection for thumbnail fetches and cancel on fast scrubs
Fallback: when previews unavailable, render compact sparkline with latency gradient
review_feedback: PM (Jordan Ruiz): add toggle to show 'cost-only' thumbnails for finance-focused users
Eng (Samir Kapoor): verify KV-cache traces don't expose sensitive keys in thumbnails; strip all values
Infra (Lena Ortiz): thumbnails must be stored in S3 with lifecycle 7 days by default
Accessibility (Ravi Mehta): ensure scrubber has aria-live announcements when the focused snapshot changes, and provide a text-only list view
decisions: Use correlation-id pinning instead of implicit grouping to avoid conflating cross-tenant traces
Thumbnail provisioning will be async: UI shows skeleton immediately and replaces with preview when available
Cost estimate shown is a best-effort client-side calculation but must reconcile with server-side billing in the Console cost view
next_steps: Address security review: add a short data-retention and redaction section to PRD (owner: Maya)
Create engineering spike to prototype snapshot endpoints and confirm payload sizes (owner: Samir)
Design QA pass for high-contrast mode and keyboard nav (owner: Avery)
Schedule design review with product and legal before shipping to beta
